rationale: Builds directly on the best late-aligned-skip recurrent-tail script, but trims one early decoder skip whenever the tail uses multi-block recurrence. The hypothesis is that the recurrent tail already supplies extra deep refinement, so concentrating encoder skip bandwidth on the last non-recurrent decoder block plus the recurrent tail blocks should improve the final int8 roundtrip metric more than replay or anchor variants did.
title: Tail-Focused Late Decoder Skips
